title: Crochet Hat pattern template
description: Reusable Markdown template for writing and sharing crochet hat patterns with sections for sizing, gauge, materials, and step-by-step directions for top-down or bottom-up construction
---

Use this reusable template to write and share your crochet hat patterns in Markdown. Fill in the bracketed sections with your pattern details. This template works for beanies, slouchy hats, berets, and brimmed hats in any stitch pattern, including colorwork.

**Related guides:** [Hat and scarf measurement guide](/reference/hat-scarf-measurement/)

## Pattern Instructions

Choose **one** construction path. Delete the other.

---

### Path A: Top-Down (Crown to Brim)

#### Crown

Begin with a magic ring.

```plaintext
Rnd 1: [N] dc in magic ring, ss in first st to join — [N] sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 2, 2 dc in each st around, ss in first st to join — [2N] sts.
Rnd 3: Ch 2, *dc in next st, 2 dc in next* around, ss in first st to join — [3N] sts.
Rnd 4: Ch 2, *dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next* around, ss in first st to join — [4N] sts.
[Continue increase rounds as needed for your size and desired circumference.]
```

**Size-specific increase schedule:**

| Size | Starting sts | Rnds to complete | Sts after crown |
|---|---|---|---|
| Newborn | [N] | [N] | [N] |
| Baby | [N] | [N] | [N] |
| Toddler | [N] | [N] | [N] |
| Child | [N] | [N] | [N] |
| S/M Adult | [N] | [N] | [N] |
| L Adult | [N] | [N] | [N] |

#### Body

```plaintext
[Work even in main stitch pattern until piece measures N in / cm from crown.]
```

**Length per size:**

| Size | Body length |
|---|---|
| [size] | [in / cm] |

**Colorwork/stripe sequence (if applicable):**

```plaintext
[Rnds 1-N]: Work in [color A]
[Rnds N-N]: Work in [color B]
[Repeat sequence as desired]
```

#### Brim

Switch to smaller hook. Do not turn.

```plaintext
Rnd 1: Ch 2, *dc in next st, fpdc around next st* around, ss in first st to join.
Rnds 2-[N]: Ch 2, *dc in next dc, fpdc around next fpdc* around, ss in first st to join.
```

Fasten off. Weave in ends.

**Alternative brim options:**
- **SC in BLO band:** Work bottom-up and start with band (see Path B).
- **Folded brim:** Work body [N] in / cm longer than desired, fold brim up.
- **Simple border:** Ch 1, sc in each st around for [N] rounds.

---

### Path B: Bottom-Up (Band to Crown)

#### Hat Band

With smaller hook and [color A], ch [N].

```plaintext
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn — [N] sts.
Rows 2-[N]: Ch 1, sc in blo of each st across, turn.
```

At the end of the final row, join the final row to the first row with a slip stitch seam to form the band ring. Continue with the same color but switch to the larger hook for the body.

#### Body

With larger hook, ch 1, sc evenly into the side of each band row. Join with ss in first st.

**Work from chart:** Work Rounds 1-[N] of Body Chart. Each round joined with ss and color changed as indicated.

**Written instructions (no chart):**

```plaintext
[Round-by-round instructions with stitch and color changes]
[Continue until piece measures N in / cm from band]
```

**Sizing adjustment:** Work fewer rounds for smaller sizes, additional rounds for larger sizes.

**Colorwork/stripe sequence (if applicable):**

```plaintext
[Rnds 1-N]: Work in [color A]
[Rnds N-N]: Work in [color B]
[Repeat sequence as desired]
```

#### Crown

Work crown decreases with current color.

```plaintext
[Decrease round: Ch 1, *sc in next N sts, sc2tog; rep from * around, ss in first st to join]
[Repeat decrease rounds as needed until N sts remain]
```

Break yarn leaving a long tail. Thread tail through every other stitch around, pull tight to close. Weave in opposite direction to secure.
